description: All platform screens, built on the FEAT-001 infrastructure (keys/types/hooks/guard/gate/step-up/shell). Dashboard (stats), Institutions (list + create-with-bootstrap-secret-reveal + suspend/activate), Module entitlement matrix, Support grants (list + create via step-up + revoke), Break-glass tenant read, and the platform Audit explorer — each wrapped in RouteGuard with its platform.* key, each with loading/empty/error/forbidden/403-no-MFA states. Plus integration tests for the step-up retry loop, the MFA-enrollment gate, and the bootstrap-secret one-time-reveal state machine. DEPENDS ON FEAT-001 (imports every features/platform/* module and components/platform/* component). Read .agents/tasks/frontend-platform-superadmin/context.json and this file FIRST; also read FEAT-001.json findings for anything it recorded.
steps: Modify apps/web/src/app/platform/page.tsx — replace the all-in-one scaffold with a stats-only dashboard: default export wraps <RouteGuard requirePermission={PLATFORM_PERM.analyticsView}> around an inner component that calls useStats(); render stat cards (institutions total/active/suspended, users total/students, movement totalPasses/currentlyOutside); route the query error through useMfaGate().reportError so a 403 'MFA enrollment required' shows enrollment (not an error). States: loading skeleton, error (describeApiError), forbidden.

Create apps/web/src/app/platform/institutions/page.tsx — <RouteGuard requirePermission={PLATFORM_PERM.institutionsManage}>; useInstitutions() table (name, code, status badge, _count users/departments/gates, actions: Link to /platform/institutions/{id}/modules + Suspend/Activate button); EmptyState 'No institutions yet.'; a 'New institution' button opening CreateInstitutionDialog; report query error to the MFA gate.

Create apps/web/src/components/platform/CreateInstitutionDialog.tsx — rhf + zodResolver(createInstitutionSchema); on submit useCreateInstitution; on 201 switch the dialog to render BootstrapSecretPanel with institution/admin.email/tempPassword from the response (local state only); 409 'Institution code already exists' / 'Admin email already in use' shown verbatim via describeApiError; domain sent undefined when blank.

Create apps/web/src/components/platform/BootstrapSecretPanel.tsx — the show-once reveal (design C.6.2 / acceptance 5): compose DialogPortal + DialogOverlay + DialogPrimitive.Content DIRECTLY (import from @/components/ui/dialog and @radix-ui/react-dialog) WITHOUT the shared DialogContent (so NO built-in X exists); set onInteractOutside={e=>e.preventDefault()} and onEscapeKeyDown={e=>e.preventDefault()}; keep Dialog open with onOpenChange ignoring close until an 'I saved it' checkbox is checked; show the tempPassword masked by default with a reveal toggle, a single copy-to-clipboard button, and the warning 'This password is shown only once and cannot be retrieved again.'; Done (enabled only after the checkbox) is the ONLY exit and clears local state. tempPassword stays in local component state — NEVER store/localStorage/queryCache/analytics/console/toast.

Create apps/web/src/components/platform/InstitutionStatusConfirm.tsx — ConfirmDialog naming the institution and warning its users lose access on suspend (symmetric activate message); confirm -> useSetInstitutionStatus with {status:'SUSPENDED'|'ACTIVE'} then invalidate platformKeys.institutions(); cancel issues no request.

Create apps/web/src/app/platform/institutions/[id]/modules/page.tsx — useParams() id; if absent/empty render <NoAccess what="this institution's modules"/>; <RouteGuard requirePermission={PLATFORM_PERM.entitlementsManage}>; render ModuleMatrix with the id.

Create apps/web/src/components/platform/ModuleMatrix.tsx — useModuleMatrix(id); render EVERY row incl. NOT_ENTITLED with a per-row grant/revoke toggle; grant via useGrantModule(id) (idempotent; invalidate matrix); revoke via useRevokeModule(id) behind a ConfirmDialog; surface the 409 {error:'Module has active or suspended dependents', blockingDependents} as a blocking inline message listing blockingDependents (state NOT flipped); show success warnings.affectedDependents as a non-blocking notice; 400 'Unknown moduleKey' / 404 verbatim.

Create apps/web/src/app/platform/support-grants/page.tsx — <RouteGuard requirePermission={PLATFORM_PERM.supportGrant}>; filters: institution picker (options from useInstitutions()) + status SimpleSelect; useSupportGrants(institutionId,status) (key includes both); render GrantList; a 'Create grant' action opening SupportGrantForm; report query error to the MFA gate.

Create apps/web/src/components/platform/SupportGrantForm.tsx — rhf + zodResolver(createSupportGrantSchema); create via useCreateSupportGrant. Flow: first submit with no token -> on PlatformStepUpError open <PlatformStepUpDialog action="support_grant.create" .../> -> onToken(token) re-runs the mutation WITH the token -> 201 (mirror components/exams/ResultsTab.tsx runPublish). On ApiError 400 err.data?.error==='Invalid body' map err.data.details.fieldErrors to per-field form.setError (first message each) with a form-level root fallback when there are no field errors — do NOT route this through describeApiError. 404 'Institution not found' verbatim. Never send grantedToUserId. Never store/log the step-up token.

Create apps/web/src/components/platform/GrantList.tsx — table of SupportGrant rows (institution, purpose, status badge, expiresAt, actions); revoke via useRevokeSupportGrant(id) behind a ConfirmDialog with an optional reason field; on success invalidate the grants list. EmptyState when none.

Create apps/web/src/app/platform/support-grants/[id]/overview/page.tsx — useParams() id (absent -> NoAccess); <RouteGuard requirePermission={PLATFORM_PERM.supportGrant}>; self-sufficient resolution (design C.6.5): call useSupportGrants() and resolve the grant by :id client-side — show a resolving skeleton while loading, <NoAccess/>/not-found if unresolvable; GATE the audited read behind resolution. Render BreakGlassWarning (persistent 'this access is audited' banner + the grant's purpose); a ConfirmDialog (names the institution, echoes purpose) gates useBreakGlassOverview(grantId, enabled=confirmed); on 200 render auditEvents + passes (body only). 403 'Break-glass access denied' / 'Institution suspended' -> forbidden inline with the exact message (no logout); 500 'Audit write failed' -> describeApiError canned + a note that the access was aborted.
Create apps/web/src/components/platform/BreakGlassWarning.tsx — a prominent persistent warning banner component taking the resolved grant purpose and institution label; used by the overview screen.

Create apps/web/src/components/platform/AuditFilters.tsx — scope select ('platform' default | 'grant'); grantId input enabled+required only when scope='grant' (disable the query until present, with an inline 'Enter a grant id' hint mirroring the server 400); limit number input clamped to [1,100] default 50 via clampAuditLimit before enabling the query.

Create apps/web/src/components/platform/AuditTable.tsx — useAuditEvents(scope,grantId,limit,enabled); render {events} newest-first; label limit as 'most recent N events' (no cursor/offset); 403 'Grant access denied' -> forbidden inline (no logout); empty events -> EmptyState; key includes scope/grantId/limit.

Create apps/web/src/components/platform/__tests__/stepUpRetry.test.tsx — integration (RTL + mocked fetch): submitting SupportGrantForm with no token -> 401 'Step-up required' opens PlatformStepUpDialog -> entering a code mints a token (mock /api/auth/mfa/verify) -> the retry carries x-step-up and yields 201; assert the operator is NOT logged out on the 401.

Create apps/web/src/components/platform/__tests__/mfaGate.test.tsx — integration: a platform screen whose first query returns 403 'MFA enrollment required' renders the enrollment CTA (not an error/logout); completing enrollment (mock mfa enroll start/verify) clears the gate and the screen reloads.

Create apps/web/src/components/platform/__tests__/bootstrapSecret.test.tsx — integration: after a 201 create, the reveal panel cannot be dismissed by Esc/outside-click/absence-of-X until 'I saved it' is checked; after Done the tempPassword is gone from the DOM; assert the secret never appears in localStorage.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` in apps/web compiles all new routes under app/platform/* and the rewritten dashboard.
`npm run lint` passes (no type errors across pages + components).
`npx vitest run src/components/platform src/features/platform` passes the integration + unit tests (step-up retry, MFA gate, bootstrap-secret state machine).
`npm test` passes the full apps/web suite (all prior tests + FEAT-001 + FEAT-002 tests green).

No new dependency in apps/web/package.json; tenant (app) modules / AppShell / /admin and components/exams/StepUpDialog.tsx remain untouched; the bootstrap tempPassword and step-up tokens appear in no store/cache/localStorage/console/toast.
verification: cd c:/campusgate/apps/web && npx vitest run src/components/platform src/features/platform
findings:
DONE. Verification all green in apps/web: `npm run lint` (tsc) exit 0; targeted `npx vitest run src/components/platform src/features/platform` = 8 files / 49 tests pass; full `npm test` = 67 files / 566 tests pass (was 64/562 after FEAT-001; +3 files / +4 tests from FEAT-002's integration tests); `npm run build` compiles with all six /platform routes (page, institutions, institutions/[id]/modules, support-grants, support-grants/[id]/overview, audit).

NEW SCREENS (app/platform/*):
- page.tsx REWRITTEN: stats-only dashboard, RouteGuard(analyticsView) + useStats, routes query error through useMfaGate().reportError (403 'MFA enrollment required' -> enrollment via the gate, not an error).
- institutions/page.tsx: RouteGuard(institutionsManage), useInstitutions table + New-institution button (CreateInstitutionDialog) + per-row Modules link + Suspend/Activate (InstitutionStatusConfirm); reports query error to the MFA gate.
- institutions/[id]/modules/page.tsx: useParams id (absent -> <NoAccess>), RouteGuard(entitlementsManage), renders ModuleMatrix.
- support-grants/page.tsx: RouteGuard(supportGrant), institution picker (SimpleSelect from useInstitutions) + status SimpleSelect, useSupportGrants(institutionId,status), GrantList + Create-grant (SupportGrantForm); reports query errors to the gate.
- support-grants/[id]/overview/page.tsx: useParams id (absent -> NoAccess), RouteGuard(supportGrant), self-sufficient resolution via useSupportGrants() resolved client-side, ConfirmDialog gates useBreakGlassOverview(grantId, confirmed); 403 'Break-glass access denied'/'Institution suspended' inline (no logout), 500 'Audit write failed' canned + aborted note.
- audit/page.tsx: RouteGuard(securityRespond), AuditFilters + AuditTable; enabled = scope==='platform' || grantId present; limit via clampAuditLimit.

NEW COMPONENTS (components/platform/*):
- CreateInstitutionDialog.tsx (rhf+zodResolver(createInstitutionSchema); domain blank -> undefined; 409 verbatim via describeApiError; on 201 hands off to BootstrapSecretPanel).
- BootstrapSecretPanel.tsx (show-once reveal: composes DialogPortal+DialogOverlay+DialogPrimitive.Content directly, NO shared DialogContent so NO X; onInteractOutside/onEscapeKeyDown preventDefault; onOpenChange ignores close until 'I saved it' checkbox; masked tempPassword + reveal toggle + single copy button + 'shown only once' warning; Done is the only exit, clears state. tempPassword stays in local state only).
- InstitutionStatusConfirm.tsx (ConfirmDialog; suspend warns users lose access / symmetric activate; useSetInstitutionStatus then invalidate platformKeys.institutions(); cancel = no request).
- ModuleMatrix.tsx (useModuleMatrix(id); renders every row incl NOT_ENTITLED with grant/revoke toggle; grant via useGrantModule; revoke via useRevokeModule behind ConfirmDialog; 409 blockingDependents inline + state NOT flipped; success warnings.affectedDependents non-blocking notice; 400/404 verbatim).
- SupportGrantForm.tsx (rhf+zodResolver(createSupportGrantSchema); useCreateSupportGrant; first submit no token -> PlatformStepUpError opens PlatformStepUpDialog action='support_grant.create' -> onToken re-runs WITH token -> 201, mirroring ResultsTab.runPublish; 400 'Invalid body' mapped to per-field setError from details.fieldErrors with form-level fallback, NOT via describeApiError; 404 verbatim; never sends grantedToUserId; never stores the step-up token. datetime-local value normalised to ISO before send).
- GrantList.tsx (table of SupportGrant rows; per-row revoke via useRevokeSupportGrant behind ConfirmDialog with an optional reason field; invalidates platformKeys.grants() on success; EmptyState when none).
- BreakGlassWarning.tsx (persistent 'this access is audited' banner; takes purpose + institutionLabel).
- AuditFilters.tsx (scope SimpleSelect platform|grant; grantId Input enabled+required only for scope=grant with inline 'Enter a grant id' hint; limit number input [1,100]).
- AuditTable.tsx (useAuditEvents(scope,grantId,limit,enabled); renders events newest-first as the server already returns; 'most recent N events' label; 403 'Grant access denied' inline no logout; EmptyState when empty; disabled state prompt).

NEW TESTS (components/platform/__tests__/*): stepUpRetry.test.tsx, mfaGate.test.tsx, bootstrapSecret.test.tsx — the FIRST RTL/integration tests in apps/web (prior suite was all pure-unit). Harness: QueryClientProvider with retry:false, vi.stubGlobal('fetch', ...) returning fake Response objects, @testing-library/react render/fireEvent/act/waitFor/cleanup. NO @testing-library/jest-dom (not installed) — assertions use plain DOM/vitest matchers; no vitest setup file was added. SupportGrantForm/CreateInstitutionDialog need no next/navigation router mock (they don't use it).

DECISIONS / DEVIATIONS:
- useRevokeModule's FEAT-001 return type omits `warnings`; ModuleMatrix reads res.warnings.affectedDependents via a local defensive cast rather than changing the hook signature.
- GrantList's revoke reason field is captured locally but NOT transmitted (FEAT-001's useRevokeSupportGrant uses api.delete with no body, per its findings). The step asked for the field; it is informational-only until the hook grows a body variant.
- No new dependency added; package.json untouched. Tenant modules/AppShell//admin and components/exams/StepUpDialog.tsx untouched; lib/landing.ts untouched. Secret hygiene honored: tempPassword and step-up tokens live only in transient component state (never store/localStorage/cache/console/toast) — bootstrapSecret.test.tsx asserts the secret never reaches localStorage and leaves the DOM after Done.
